purpose: Acquire wider WISE W1 stellar-light coverage after P0739 honestly failed its frozen SINGS-footprint gate for NGC2403 and NGC5055. The supplement is applied uniformly to all development, validation, and holdout systems before any validation, holdout, velocity, or dispersion array is opened.

parents.failedRegistrationFinding: The only failed P0739 engineering gate was minimum joint stellar/H I footprint inside the published H I R995: NGC2403=0.8715 and NGC5055=0.8024 versus the frozen 0.90 minimum.

selectionPolicy.coaddRule: Freeze every W1 coadd returned by the official IBE metadata query that overlaps the centered requested square; mosaic the frozen set without choosing tiles from image appearance.
selectionPolicy.cutoutDiameter: Twice the P0739 face-on half-extent, converted from physical size using the published SPARC distance. This bounds the projected footprint because projection compresses the minor axis.
selectionPolicy.splitRule: Acquire bytes for all eight systems now, but do not open validation or holdout image arrays until their later unlock manifests.
selectionPolicy.calibrationRule: Use SINGS IRAC1 wherever its valid weight map exists. In development only, estimate one per-galaxy WISE-to-SINGS photometric scale from robust overlapping, background-subtracted pixels; use scaled WISE only outside the SINGS footprint. This is an observational cross-calibration and must never use kinematics or gravity predictions.
selectionPolicy.resolutionRule: Convolve the fused stellar morphology to the same THINGS beam used for gas before mass normalization.
selectionPolicy.massRule: Retain the P0739 universal stellar M/L=0.5 and normalize the completed stellar morphology to the published 3.6 micron luminosity. WISE does not introduce a gravity parameter or a second stellar mass normalization.

claimBoundary: P0740 repairs observational coverage; it cannot validate or improve a gravity formula.
AllWISE W1 and SINGS IRAC1 have different filters, PSFs, backgrounds, and foreground contamination; their cross-calibration uncertainty must be propagated later.
Downloading validation and holdout bytes does not unseal their image arrays.
No velocity, dispersion, dark-matter, MOND, or candidate-theory value may select, scale, mask, or mosaic these images.
